item.title: Legislators discuss state budget proposal at RCPA Legislative Breakfast
item.description: WILKES-BARRE — Richard S. Edley, PhD, President & CEO of the Rehabilitation & Community Providers Association (RCPA), hosted a Legislative Breakfast Friday morning to discuss and advocate for issues members face.

item.title: US sets up gold-medal game vs. Canada by cruising past Slovakia
item.description: MILAN — Zach Werenski and his U.S. teammates tried not to look ahead at a potential gold-medal game against Canada at the Olympics. After each went unbeaten in group play, there was no way the North American rivals could meet before the final, but there was work left to do.

item.title: What happens next after the Supreme Court slapped down Trump’s tariffs
item.description: WASHINGTON — There’s little that Donald Trump has cherished more in his second term than tariffs, a symbol of his imperious approach to the presidency. He has raised and lowered them at will, rewriting the rules of global commerce and daring anyone to stop him.

item.title: D2 Basketball Roundup: Dallas rallies to beat Valley View in 4A semis
item.description: Pat Flanagan led the way with 20 points and the top-seeded Dallas Mountaineers erased a 10-point deficit at the half to defeat Valley View 46-43 in the District 2 Class 4A semifinals on Friday night.

item.title: District 2 Boys Basketball: Wyoming Area falls to Scranton Prep in semifinals
item.description: SCRANTON — Packy Doherty nearly kept up with Luke Kopetchny in a battle of two of District 2’s most explosive offensive boys basketball players and Doherty’s Scranton Prep teammates all joined forces on the boards Friday night.

item.title: District 2 wrestling championships underway, champs crowned Saturday
item.description: PLAINS TWP. — Two traditional powers controlled the top of the boys’ leaderboards after the opening day of the District 2 Wrestling Championships, while a Wyoming Valley Conference program sits in pole position in the girls’ tournament.

item.title: District 2 Girls Basketball: Holy Redeemer heading back to 3A title game
item.description: WILKES-BARRE — Once the initial shock wore off, Holy Redeemer went about Friday night accomplishing what it had done the previous three years. The Royals ended Lake-Lehman’s season.

item.title: Robert Hughes: Volunteers vital to nation and nonprofits
item.description: As the United States prepares to celebrate its 250th anniversary this year, there’s a big effort across the nation to promote what has been a cornerstone of our country from the start: volunteerism.
